text:
jordan_sales: quick sync — AcmePilot POC is greenlit but procurement hit a blocker. They want net60 on the PO, vendor insists net30 in their orderform, and legal flagged the DPA subprocessor clause. need help routing signatures and a clean esign flow to avoid delay.

maria_legal: @jordan_sales can you drop the redline blob? which clause specifically on the DPA?

jordan_sales: sending pdf in the thread, clause is 4.2 subproc rights + the vendor wants to keep indemnity language. also price: they requested a 20% usage credit for the pilot.

ethan_finance: net60 is doable for internal approval but we need a PO that matches the counterparty terms or an exec approval for extended terms. do we have a billing contact?

sara_se: POC timeline is 4 weeks. we should avoid gating kickoff on final signature — we can start onboarding subject to a signed orderform. tech side ok to start sandbox access.

katie_ops: for esign routing, recommend:
```
1) Sales (jordan) -> Customer PO signer (procurement)
2) Legal (maria) countersign (if DPA redlines accepted)
3) Finance (ethan) finalizes PO terms
4) Ops (katie) triggers account provisioning on signed signal
```
This keeps execution linear.

maria_legal: if customer requires net60 and vendor insists net30 we can add a short term SOW note: billing cadence net30 but payment terms net60 for this pilot with a 1% interest waiver. need countersign from VP Sales for deviation.

jordan_sales: tagging @olivia_custsuccess for acceptance criteria so we don't ship before verifying telemetry hooks.

olivia_custsuccess: will prepare the POC success checklist and share with the customer today.

ethan_finance: ok on the hybrid term but we need to capture it in an amendment to the orderform. can you get procurement to ACK? also we prefer bank transfer net60; if customer insists card we'll need to change invoicing.

katie_ops: one more note — Docusign template must include the MSA reference #MSA-2025-42 and a separate DPA attachment. avoids bundling redlines into the orderform body.

jordan_sales: got it. action items: 1) maria to propose DPA redline response, 2) ethan to confirm amendment language, 3) olivia to send POC checklist, 4) katie to prepare esign envelope template. i'll ping the customer for PO signer contact.

maria_legal: drafting a response — will push a tracked-change DPA and a one-paragraph indemnity cap concession. ready in ~2 business hours.

ethan_finance: I'll prepare two amendment snippets: (A) net30 billing/net60 payment for pilot, (B) standard net30. share which to attach once maria confirms.

sara_se: devs can start sandbox access today. let me know final list of accounts to provision.

esign-bot: Document MSA-2025-42 and DPA-ACME uploaded to /legal/esigns/2765432101/ — envelope template draft saved.

jordan_sales: perfect. keeping this short — will loop back after maria's redline. thanks all :pray:
